FROM postgres:17-bookworm

# Install PostGIS and pgRouting for PostgreSQL 17.
# The previous base (postgis/postgis:17-3.5) is Debian bullseye based, and the
# upstream PGDG bullseye repository has been removed, so postgis and pgRouting
# are installed from the still-maintained bookworm-pgdg repository instead.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        postgresql-17-postgis-3 \
        postgresql-17-pgrouting && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
